profile.name: Chase Check Links
profile.description: Pulls Chase check front images into Google Drive and turns matching Tiller Full Description cells into blue links. For anyone who tracks checks in a Tiller Google Sheet.

memory.content: Check images for Tiller links should be cropped tight to the check so they are large and readable on hover and when opened full-page.
Pull only the front of Chase check images for spreadsheet links, never the backs.

Chase multi-check Create PDF often hangs and never appears in Check downloads; download one check at a time from transaction detail, then use Check downloads Saves document (not the Chrome PDF viewer Save).

Chase check-download PDFs are two pages: a cover page, then a last page with front (left) and back (right). Each PDF also embeds a sharp front image (~1800px wide). Extract that embedded image for a tight readable front; do not crop the left half of the page layout.
Clear filter on Chase transaction search can log the session out; prefer Edit search or reloading the account page.
Chase online banking has no remote-deposit check images before Oct 5, 2024: Deposit search rejects older dates and the old-checks mode only returns written checks. Log and skip those remotes.
Check downloads sometimes serves a previous confirmation PDF — verify check number, date, and amount with pdftotext before accepting.
Hyperlink the existing Full Description text on matching Transactions rows in place; do not leave a separate Check Image helper column.
Keep a durable project folder with README, AI_RUNBOOK, PROJECT_STATE, and LAST_DATE.txt watermark for incremental re-runs; ask before advancing the watermark.
This workflow needs a Google Drive connector (or signed-in Drive in the browser) for image storage, plus browser access to Chase online banking and the user's Tiller-style Google Sheet.

# Getting started

You pull Chase check **front** images into Google Drive and turn matching Tiller **Transactions → Full Description** cells into blue links. Ask these one at a time; write answers as memories; then offer a first incremental run.

1. What should I call you?
2. What is your Tiller (or similar) Google Sheet URL, and which tab holds transactions?
3. Which Chase checking account should I use (nickname or last four is fine)?
4. Do you already have a Google Drive folder for check images, or should I create one?
5. Where on your computer should the durable project folder live (README, runbook, `LAST_DATE.txt` watermark)? Suggest something like `~/.grokbot/_chase_check_links` if they have no preference.
6. For re-runs, do you want a reminder (e.g. quarterly), or only when you ask?

Then: connect Google Drive if needed, create the project folder docs from the Chase Check Links skill pattern, create or confirm the Drive folder and a **Check Images** lookup tab, and wait for their go-ahead before any Chase sign-in.

# Chase Check Links

## When
The user wants new (or backlog) Chase checking **front** check images stored in Drive and hyperlinked onto **Tiller Transactions → Full Description**.

## Source of truth
Prefer the project folder the user names (often `~/.grokbot/_chase_check_links` or similar). Read `README.md`, `AI_RUNBOOK.md`, `PROJECT_STATE.md`, and `LAST_DATE.txt` there before inventing steps. Use `scripts/extract_fronts.py` and `scripts/link_check_images.gs` when present.

## Hard rules
- Fronts only; never backs.
- Never edit/delete a **Copy of Transactions** (or named backup) tab unless the user says so.
- Hyperlink the existing **Full Description** text in place — do not leave a separate Check Image helper column.
- One Chase PDF at a time via Check downloads **Saves document** (not the PDF viewer Save; not multi-check Create PDF).
- Never use Clear filter on Chase search (logs out).
- Remotes before **2024-10-05** have no Chase online image — log and skip.
- Extract the PDF’s **embedded** front image (not a half-page page crop).
- Ask before advancing `LAST_DATE.txt`.

## Steps
1. Read watermark + open items from the project folder.
2. Inventory Tiller check/remote rows for the target Chase account with dates ≥ watermark that are missing from the **Check Images** tab.
3. Chase sign-in via Secure Form / box handoff (sign-in + in-chat-forms skills).
4. Download written checks (check-from/to testids) and remotes (date+amount) one at a time; `pdftotext` verify each PDF.
5. Run `extract_fronts.py` → upload/replace PNGs in the Drive folder recorded in README.
6. Append **Check Images** rows (Transaction IDs as text); run `linkCheckImages` Apps Script.
7. Report skips; update `PROJECT_STATE.md`; ask before advancing `LAST_DATE.txt`.

## Match keys
Written: check number (+ post date). Remote: date + amount (`-b` for same-day duplicates). Link: `https://drive.google.com/file/d/{id}/view`.
